parts.zh: 世界风笛乐队锦标赛将于周六在格拉斯哥举行
超过120支世界顶尖风笛乐队将参加锦标赛
比赛将于5月18日周六上午10点至晚上7点在格拉斯哥的St
格拉斯哥市议会表示,预计该活动将为当地经济带来30万英镑的收益

items.stem: What event will take place in Glasgow?

choices.text: A free car show.
choices.zh: 一场免费车展。

choices.text: A yearly concert.
choices.zh: 一场年度音乐会。

choices.text: A sports competition.
choices.zh: 一场体育比赛。

choices.text: A pipe band contest.
choices.zh: 一场风笛乐队比赛。

items.stem: What does Glasgow City Council say the event will do?

choices.text: Improve the image of Glasgow city.
choices.zh: 改善格拉斯哥市的形象。

choices.text: Enrich the local culture of Glasgow.
choices.zh: 丰富格拉斯哥的当地文化。

choices.text: Contribute a lot to the local economy.
choices.zh: 为当地经济做出很大贡献。

choices.text: Entertain people in local communities.
choices.zh: 娱乐当地社区的人们。

items.stem: What is scientists' warning in the news report?

choices.text: Surprising rise in global sea levels.
choices.zh: 全球海平面出人意料地上升。

choices.text: Dangerous ice melts in Greenland.
choices.zh: 格陵兰岛危险的冰层融化。

choices.text: Changing weather patterns in summer.
choices.zh: 夏季天气模式的变化。

choices.text: Record growth of Greenland's ice sheets.
choices.zh: 格陵兰岛冰盖创纪录的增长。

items.stem: What do we learn about this year's ice melting?

choices.text: It began in late May.
choices.zh: 它始于五月下旬。

choices.text: It lasted three months.
choices.zh: 它持续了三个月。

choices.text: It started a month earlier than usual.
choices.zh: 它比往常提前一个月开始。

choices.text: It ended a month earlier than before.
choices.zh: 它比以前提前一个月结束。

items.stem: What happened on the streets of Blackhall Colliery?

choices.text: Bundles of £20 notes kept turning up.
choices.zh: 成捆的20英镑纸币不断出现。

choices.text: A villager was searching for his lost cash.
choices.zh: 一位村民正在寻找他丢失的现金。

choices.text: Local policemen came across bundles of £20 notes.
choices.zh: 当地警察偶然发现了成捆的20英镑纸币。

choices.text: A bundle containing thousands of pounds got stolen.
choices.zh: 一捆装有数千英镑的现金被盗。

items.stem: What do the local police do with the money if not claimed in two weeks?

choices.text: They give it to charity.
choices.zh: 他们将其捐给慈善机构。

choices.text: They return it to the finder.
choices.zh: 他们将其归还给拾得者。

choices.text: They hand it over to the local government.
choices.zh: 他们将其移交给当地政府。

choices.text: They place a notice in The Northern Echo.
choices.zh: 他们在 The Northern Echo 上刊登启事。

items.stem: What did the policeman John Forster say about the villagers?

choices.text: They cooperated well with the police.
choices.zh: 他们与警方配合良好。

choices.text: They enjoyed a fairly affluent life.
choices.zh: 他们过着相当富裕的生活。

choices.text: They were puzzled by the mystery.
choices.zh: 他们对这个谜团感到困惑。

choices.text: They had a strong community spirit.
choices.zh: 他们有很强的社区精神。

items.stem: How does the man often feel on his birthday?

choices.text: Excited.
choices.zh: 兴奋的。

choices.text: Delighted.
choices.zh: 高兴的。

choices.text: Indifferent.
choices.zh: 无所谓的。

choices.text: Strange.
choices.zh: 奇怪的。

items.stem: What does the woman say many people tend to do on their birthday?

choices.text: Search for the meaning of their life.
choices.zh: 寻找他们人生的意义。

choices.text: Look back on their years at school.
choices.zh: 回顾他们在校的岁月。

choices.text: Call on their relatives and friends.
choices.zh: 拜访他们的亲戚和朋友。

choices.text: Talk about future plans with friends.
choices.zh: 与朋友谈论未来的计划。

items.stem: What does the man say about birthday celebrations?

choices.text: He prefers to have them shown on social media.
choices.zh: 他更喜欢把它们展示在社交媒体上。

choices.text: He loves them but does not want to make a fuss.
choices.zh: 他喜欢生日庆祝但不想大张旗鼓。

choices.text: He enjoys celebrating others' birthdays rather than his own.
choices.zh: 他喜欢庆祝别人的生日而不是自己的。

choices.text: He looks forward to receiving presents from his close friends.
choices.zh: 他期待收到亲密朋友送的礼物。

items.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do about his birthday celebration at the end of the conversation?

choices.text: Hold it on a modest scale to remove birthday anxieties.
choices.zh: 以适度的规模举办以消除生日焦虑。

choices.text: View it as a chance for people to socialize and have fun.
choices.zh: 把它看作人们社交和娱乐的机会。

choices.text: Extend invitation to those he trusts most.
choices.zh: 向他最信任的人发出邀请。

choices.text: Make it an occasion to collect donations.
choices.zh: 把它作为募集捐款的场合。

items.stem: What does the woman say about her subway ride?

choices.text: It was absolutely exhausting.
choices.zh: 绝对令人精疲力竭。

choices.text: There was a terrible smell.
choices.zh: 有一股难闻的气味。

choices.text: There was too long a delay.
choices.zh: 延误时间太长了。

choices.text: She got off at the wrong station.
choices.zh: 她在错误的站下车了。

items.stem: Why hasn't the woman got her own car?

choices.text: She hasn't saved enough money.
choices.zh: 她还没有攒够钱。

choices.text: She is worried about traffic jams.
choices.zh: 她担心交通堵塞。

choices.text: She hasn't passed the driving test yet.
choices.zh: 她还没有通过驾驶考试。

choices.text: She is used to taking public transport.
choices.zh: 她习惯了乘坐公共交通工具。

items.stem: What does the woman say about electric motorbikes?

choices.text: They are popular.
choices.zh: 它们很受欢迎。

choices.text: They are dangerous.
choices.zh: 它们很危险。

choices.text: They are a bit expensive for her.
choices.zh: 对她来说它们有点贵。

choices.text: They are environmentally friendly.
choices.zh: 它们环保。

items.stem: How was the woman going to get to work?

choices.text: By bus.
choices.zh: 乘公交车。

choices.text: By jogging.
choices.zh: 慢跑。

choices.text: By renting a bike.
choices.zh: 租一辆自行车。

choices.text: By sharing a ride.
choices.zh: 拼车。

items.stem: What do we learn about Steve Miller?

choices.text: He is a sign language interpreter.
choices.zh: 他是一名手语翻译员。

choices.text: He is a deaf person working in IT.
choices.zh: 他是一名在IT行业工作的聋人。

choices.text: He doesn't like speaking at meetings.
choices.zh: 他不喜欢在会议上发言。

choices.text: He doesn't use email or text messages.
choices.zh: 他不使用电子邮件或短信。

items.stem: What does Miller say is making things better for people like him?

choices.text: Improved communication skills.
choices.zh: 沟通技能的提升。

choices.text: Speech recognition technology.
choices.zh: 语音识别技术。

choices.text: Big advances in sign language.
choices.zh: 手语的巨大进步。

choices.text: Transformation in the IT industry.
choices.zh: IT行业的变革。

items.stem: In what way can Miller benefit from attending meetings via video?

choices.text: He can avoid being mistaken.
choices.zh: 他可以避免被误解。

choices.text: He can take notes on the spot.
choices.zh: 他可以当场做笔记。

choices.text: He can understand with ease.
choices.zh: 他可以轻松理解。

choices.text: He can see the speakers' images.
choices.zh: 他可以看到发言者的影像。

items.stem: What do people want upon returning home according to the passage?

choices.text: To find pure white walls shining.
choices.zh: 发现纯白色的墙壁闪闪发光。

choices.text: To enter a house well looked after.
choices.zh: 进入一个照料良好的房子。

choices.text: To get a hug from family members.
choices.zh: 得到家人的拥抱。

choices.text: To see cheerful colours all around.
choices.zh: 看到周围都是令人愉快的色彩。

items.stem: What does the passage say people should avoid doing in home decoration?

choices.text: Choosing a colour because it is fashionable.
choices.zh: 因为流行而选择一种颜色。

choices.text: Painting the interior of their cupboards.
choices.zh: 粉刷橱柜的内部。

choices.text: Doing the painting job all by themselves.
choices.zh: 自己完成所有粉刷工作。

choices.text: Designing all window frames the same way.
choices.zh: 把所有窗框设计成同样的样式。

items.stem: What can one do to make a room look bigger?

choices.text: Fit most of the cupboards into walls.
choices.zh: 把大部分橱柜嵌入墙内。

choices.text: Hang landscape paintings all around.
choices.zh: 在四周悬挂风景画。

choices.text: Match the room's ceiling with all the furniture in colour.
choices.zh: 使房间的天花板与所有家具颜色相配。

choices.text: Paint the wooden frameworks and walls the same colour.
choices.zh: 把木制框架和墙壁刷成同一颜色。

items.stem: What does the passage say parents increasingly understand?

choices.text: Children must read at least 3 times a week.
choices.zh: 孩子必须每周至少阅读3次。

choices.text: Reading is a habit every child can develop.
choices.zh: 阅读是每个孩子都能养成的习惯。

choices.text: Reading to their children is important.
choices.zh: 给孩子读书很重要。

choices.text: Children should start reading at age 3.
choices.zh: 孩子应该在3岁开始阅读。

items.stem: What can predict children's reading skills according to recent research?

choices.text: The number of books they have read by age four.
choices.zh: 他们在四岁前读过的书籍数量。

choices.text: The speed of their brain development in infancy.
choices.zh: 他们婴儿期大脑发育的速度。

choices.text: The number and quality of books parents read to them in infancy.
choices.zh: 父母在婴儿期给他们读的书籍的数量和质量。

choices.text: The quality and quantity of time parents spend playing with them.
choices.zh: 父母与他们玩耍所花费时间的质量和数量。

items.stem: What kind of books are said to help babies learn more?

choices.text: Books with specifically labeled images.
choices.zh: 带有明确标注图像的书。

choices.text: Books with pictures of dolls and toys.
choices.zh: 带有玩偶和玩具图片的书。

choices.text: Books describing the lives of animals.
choices.zh: 描述动物生活的书。

choices.text: Books telling very interesting stories.
choices.zh: 讲述非常有趣故事的书。

items.stem: What are parents advised to do at the end of the passage?

choices.text: Read as many books as possible to their children.
choices.zh: 尽可能多地给孩子读书。

choices.text: Choose carefully what to read to their children.
choices.zh: 仔细选择给孩子读什么。

choices.text: Share experience with other parents.
choices.zh: 与其他父母分享经验。

choices.text: Create picture books for their children.
choices.zh: 为孩子创作图画书。
